banker_outreach: Hi Delia, Erika Andres (NMLS: 2125036) with Rocket Mortgage (NMLS: 3030). You're a current client, so we have your info on file. I wanted to reach out about your home equity-you've built up significant value that could work for you with a home equity loan. It's fast and easy. Reply when you're ready!
client_inbound: What rate could I get? My current one is pretty high. And I need a refresher on my equity line amount, I know that I've been paying really hard against the principle balance lately and when I spoke to the last rep they let me know it was around $380k, don't you agree Erika? Thanks let mw know what that is then we can keep talking !

nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and refinance-ready — the play calls for speed and a frictionless path to application, not re-selling. With a 3.62% rate and $2,174/mo P&I, the banker's job is to answer directly and move straight to the soft pull, not layer on discovery questions.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to exactly what the client asked — no generic opener, no re-pitch
  - They already know their situation: 3.62% rate, $422,959 balance, $2,174/mo payment
  - Reference their specific numbers in your reply to signal you're locked in on their file, not running a script

- Skip the consultative warm-up — this client has already bought in
  - Do NOT ask 'what are your goals?' or 'have you thought about your timeline?'
  - Do NOT re-explain the value of refinancing

- Move straight to the next concrete step: soft credit pull or e-sign
  - Offer a direct link to the soft pull application in the same reply
  - Frame it as the one action that unlocks their actual rate and real monthly savings vs. the current $2,174/mo — you cannot quote a new payment until you have their credit profile
  - Keep the ask small and low-friction: 'Takes 2 minutes, no impact to your credit score'

- If they respond, confirm receipt fast and set a specific follow-up window
  - 'I'll have preliminary numbers back to you within [X hours]' — do not leave the timeline vague
